contatto.testo: Write to us and we'll reply within 48 hours.
privacy.1.testo:
The data controller is Kalima Media Lab, based in Milan (Italy).
Contact: {email}
privacy.2.testo:
kalimamedialab.com is a presentation website: it has no accounts or newsletter. It only collects:

  • Technical browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, kept temporarily in the server logs for security and diagnostics.
  • Contact form data: name, email, organization (optional), chosen topic and message. They are used only to reply to you.
  • Data you send us: if you email us, your address and the content of your message.
privacy.3.testo:
The site does not use profiling cookies, advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies. It uses a single technical cookie:

  • kalima_lingua: remembers the language you chose, so you find it again on your next visit. It lasts one year and contains no personal data.

As a technical cookie, it does not require consent.
privacy.4.testo:
• Anthropic (Claude): the text of the contact form is sent to Claude, the artificial intelligence of Anthropic PBC (United States), which prepares the first automatic reply and a summary for us. Anthropic processes the data on our behalf, does not use it to train its models, and the transfer is covered by the EU standard contractual clauses. The automatic reply is labelled as such, and then a person replies to you.
  • Sending emails: replies are sent through our email provider.
  • Google Fonts: the site's fonts are loaded from Google's servers, which receive your browser's IP address.
  • Arabita and Banglita: news headlines are read by our server; your browser does not contact those sites until you click a link.
  • Social networks: links to Instagram, Facebook and Telegram lead to external sites with their own privacy policies.
privacy.5.testo:
• Operating and securing the site
  • Remembering your chosen language
  • Replying to people who write to us, including with a first automatic reply (legal basis: your request and your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR)
privacy.6.testo: Personal data is not sold, transferred or shared with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes. The site does not include Facebook tracking pixels, Google Analytics or any other third-party analytics service.
privacy.7.testo: Technical browsing data is kept in the server logs for a maximum of 30 days. Contact form messages are not stored on the website: they reach us by email and, like the emails we receive, are kept for as long as needed to reply and to manage any relationship that follows, up to 24 months if no relationship follows.
privacy.8.testo:
Under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR), you have the right to:

  • Access: obtain confirmation of whether data about you exists
  • Rectification: correct inaccurate data
  • Erasure: ask for your data to be deleted ("right to be forgotten")
  • Portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Objection: object to processing at any time

To exercise these rights: {email}
privacy.9.testo: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (garanteprivacy.it).

meta.titolo: Kalima Media Lab · Bilingual media, Italian school and AI for nonprofits
meta.descrizione: Arabita and Banglita, bilingual news outlets; Kalima School, online Italian in 24 languages; artificial intelligence for NGOs and nonprofits.
ong.titolo: Artificial intelligence for NGOs and nonprofits
ong.meta: Project archives in order, clean databases, project analysis and writing, lighter administration: artificial intelligence working for NGOs and nonprofits.
ong.sotto: Less time on archives, spreadsheets and deadlines. More time for people.
ong.1.d: Years of projects, reports and scattered documents in a single archive you can search with plain questions: “which projects did we run with migrant women since 2018, and with which partners?”
ong.2.d: Beneficiary, volunteer and donor records without duplicates, with consistent fields and fast search, GDPR compliant.
ong.3.d: Finding the right calls, writing proposals for foundations, public bodies and EU funds, logical framework, budget and reporting.
ong.4.d: From surveys, interviews and public data to a clear report, ready for a grant application or your board.
ong.5.d: Minutes, periodic reports, recurring replies and repetitive documents automated where possible, always checked by a person.
ong.6.d: Websites, newsletters and social media in English, Italian and the languages of the communities you work with.
ong.perche.t: We already do it for ourselves
ong.perche.d: Arabita and Banglita are bilingual newsrooms with automated translation and publishing. Kalima School teaches Italian in 24 languages. We use the same tools we offer you every day.
ong.come.1: Write to us through the form and get a first reply right away.
ong.come.2: We send you a written plan, with timing and costs.
ong.come.3: We work in small steps, testing before every change.
servizi.ong.d: We bring order to years of projects and data, help you analyse and write your projects, and lighten your administration.

media.titolo: A bilingual news outlet for your community
media.meta: We design and launch bilingual online news outlets for communities, diaspora associations and institutions: newsroom, AI-assisted translation, automatic publishing to website and social media.
media.sotto: News in your readers' language and in Italian. Ready to use, run by a small newsroom.
media.1.d: Both languages side by side in every article, search, categories and pages optimized for Google in both languages.
media.2.d: A dashboard to write, translate and review. AI prepares translation, summary and tags; a person checks and publishes.
media.3.d: Every article goes out on Telegram, Facebook and Instagram, with graphic carousels in both languages.
media.4.d: A dictionary of the words used in the articles: the outlet also helps readers learn Italian.
media.perche.t: Arabita and Banglita are the proof
media.perche.d: Arabita (Italian-Arabic) and Banglita (Italian-Bengali) are ours and run every day on this system. Your outlet is built with the same tools.
media.come.1: You tell us about the community, the language and who will write.
media.come.2: We show you a prototype with your name and colours.
media.come.3: We train your newsroom and stay by your side after launch.
materiali.meta: Worksheets, exercises, audio and interactive H5P modules for Italian schools, cultural centres and NGOs, in the students' languages.
materiali.sotto: Materials for teaching Italian starting from the learner's own language.
materiali.1.d: Bilingual PDFs by level, from A1 to B2, with grammar explained in the students' language.
materiali.2.d: H5P modules and quizzes for online platforms or the classroom, with automatic marking.
materiali.3.d: Dialogues and vocabulary read by natural voices, in both languages.
materiali.4.d: Materials for specific goals: A2 and citizenship tests, work, healthcare, tourism.
materiali.perche.t: We already use them in our school
materiali.perche.d: Kalima School teaches Italian online in 24 languages, with a DITALS II certified teacher. The materials we offer you are created and tested there.
materiali.come.1: You tell us the level, the students' languages and the goals.
materiali.come.2: We send you a sample worksheet to approve.
materiali.come.3: We prepare the rest and adapt it after the first lessons.
comunicazione.meta: Content strategy, multilingual SEO and social media for organizations that speak to audiences in different languages: we write, translate and publish.
comunicazione.sotto: Be found and understood, in every language of your audience.
comunicazione.1.d: One page per language, clear addresses, right-to-left writing where needed, the right fonts for every script.
comunicazione.2.d: Keywords researched language by language, tailored titles and descriptions, correct signals for Google.
comunicazione.3.d: Editorial calendar, texts and graphics in your audience's languages, scheduled publishing.
comunicazione.4.d: AI translates fast, a person checks tone, terms and meaning.
comunicazione.perche.d: kalimamedialab.com is in 27 languages, and Arabita and Banglita publish every day in two scripts. The same method works for your organization.
comunicazione.come.1: We analyse your audience, languages and search terms.
comunicazione.come.2: We propose a plan with priorities and costs.
comunicazione.come.3: We publish, measure and adjust every month.
